set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 11a.

Problem:
Fs2CommandExecutor.processResource (local/Fs2CommandExecutor.scala:78-81) maps every IOException to SpawnFailureKind.Unknown. NoSuchFileException and AccessDeniedException are IOExceptions, so ExecutableMissing and PermissionDenied are only ever produced from configuration checks, never from the operating system. The enum promises finer classification than the interpreter delivers.

Acceptance:
- NoSuchFileException maps to ExecutableMissing, AccessDeniedException to PermissionDenied, and working-directory and environment failures to their respective kinds where distinguishable.
- Unrecognized IOExceptions remain Unknown with bounded evidence.
- Tests cover a missing executable path and a non-executable file.
set.title: P6f.38: Classify real spawn failures into SpawnFailureKind
